description: This file contains the implementation of the STM32 I2S low-level driver for Zephyr RTOS, including clock management, DMA handling, configuration, and interrupt handling for I2S peripherals.

methods.name: div_round_closest
methods.description: Calculates the closest integer division result with rounding.

methods.name: queue_get
methods.description: Retrieves a data block from the ring buffer queue.

methods.name: queue_put
methods.description: Adds a data block to the ring buffer queue.

methods.name: i2s_stm32_enable_clock
methods.description: Enables the clock for the I2S peripheral.

methods.name: i2s_stm32_set_clock
methods.description: Configures the I2S clock prescaler based on desired bit clock frequency.

methods.name: i2s_stm32_configure
methods.description: Configures the I2S interface with specified parameters.

methods.name: i2s_stm32_trigger
methods.description: Handles trigger commands (start, stop, drain, drop, prepare) for I2S streams.

methods.name: i2s_stm32_read
methods.description: Reads data from the I2S receive buffer.

methods.name: i2s_stm32_write
methods.description: Writes data to the I2S transmit buffer.

methods.name: i2s_stm32_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the I2S device, including clock, pinctrl, and DMA setup.

methods.name: rx_stream_start
methods.description: Starts the RX DMA stream for I2S.

methods.name: tx_stream_start
methods.description: Starts the TX DMA stream for I2S.

methods.name: rx_stream_disable
methods.description: Disables the RX DMA stream and related configurations.

methods.name: tx_stream_disable
methods.description: Disables the TX DMA stream and related configurations.

methods.name: rx_queue_drop
methods.description: Drops all queued RX data blocks.

methods.name: tx_queue_drop
methods.description: Drops all queued TX data blocks.

methods.name: get_dev_from_rx_dma_channel
methods.description: Returns the device associated with a given RX DMA channel.

methods.name: get_dev_from_tx_dma_channel
methods.description: Returns the device associated with a given TX DMA channel.

methods.name: dma_rx_callback
methods.description: DMA callback for RX stream, handles received data and errors.

methods.name: dma_tx_callback
methods.description: DMA callback for TX stream, handles sent data and errors.

methods.name: i2s_stm32_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for I2S errors and events.
